script.text: The Friendship Cup concluded with a new champion: Yuya Sakaki!
I relinquish my crown to you… for now. But believe me, I'll regain it soon enough.
Let him hear it, New Domino City! He earned it today!
My fellow citizens, now that our Friendship Cup has reached its exhilarating conclusion…
The Council has deemed this an ideal moment to announce some momentous news that will impact the whole city!
We have come to realize that if New Domino City is to survive, everyone in our society must come together.
That goal seemed impossible, but today, Jack and Yuya showed us the city can be unified.
New Domino will no longer be divided in two!
